name: run-sheet
title: Function run sheet
for_each: select id,name from events where status in ('tentative','confirmed') order by name

sections.title: Booking
sections.sql: select e.name,c.name customer,e.status,e.guests,e.numbers_confirmed,e.final_numbers_due from events e join customers c on c.id=e.customer_id where e.id=$1

sections.title: Rooms and times
sections.sql: select session,room,local_start,local_end,timezone,guests,capacity from function_diary where event_id=$1 order by starts_at

sections.title: Menu and equipment
sections.sql: select name,kind,quantity,allergens,allergen_verified,service_at from items where event_id=$1 order by service_at nulls last,name

sections.title: Staff
sections.sql: select st.name,st.role,s.starts_at,s.ends_at from shifts s join staff st on st.id=s.staff_id where s.event_id=$1 order by starts_at

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_at from tasks where event_id=$1 and not done order by due_at
